# FormFix

> FormFix is a free, 100% client-side Progressive Web App (PWA) that resizes Indian exam photos (20KB–50KB), signatures (10KB–20KB), creates 4x6 passport print sheets (6 photos at 300 DPI), adds optional Agniveer/SSC Name & Date slates, converts images between JPG/PNG/WebP, and converts document images to PDF — all inside the browser with zero server upload of user photos or documents.

FormFix runs entirely on the client using HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript (Canvas API), and a custom PDF builder. No backend, no login, no file uploads. The site is ad-supported; third-party ad networks may use cookies, but user photos and documents are never sent to any server.

## Core Tools

- [FormFix Resizer](https://formfix-in.pages.dev/): Main app — Photo Resizer (with optional Agniveer/SSC Name & Date slate), Signature Resizer, 4x6 Print Sheet, Image to PDF, and Format Converter (JPG/PNG/WebP).
- [Privacy Policy](https://formfix-in.pages.dev/privacy.html): How FormFix handles data (no uploads, local-only processing, ad disclosure).
- [Terms of Service](https://formfix-in.pages.dev/terms.html): Usage terms for FormFix.

## Features

- Photo Resizer: Resize exam/passport photos to exact KB targets (e.g., 20KB, 50KB) with optional width/height in pixels.
- Signature Resizer: Prepare crisp 10KB–20KB signatures for Indian government forms.
- 4x6 Print Sheet: Arrange 6 passport photos on a 300 DPI 4x6 inch sheet (1800x1200 px) for home/studio printing.
- Image to PDF: Convert document images (marksheets, IDs) into compressed PDFs.
- Format Converter: Convert between JPG, PNG, and WebP offline.
- Agniveer/SSC Slate: Optionally stamp Candidate Name and Date of Photo (DOP) on the photo.
- Dark mode, mobile-friendly, installable as a PWA, offline-capable via service worker.

## Supported Use Cases

- Indian government exam photo/signature uploads (SSC, UPSC, UP Police, Agniveer, etc.)
- Passport, PAN card, and job portal photo preparation
- CSC and cyber cafe document preparation
- Marksheet/ID to PDF conversion

## Privacy

- All image and PDF processing happens locally in the browser.
- No user photos, signatures, or documents are uploaded to any server.
- No account or login required.
- Ads are served by third-party networks which may use cookies.

## Tech

- Frontend: HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript (Canvas API, custom PDF builder)
- PWA: Installable, offline-capable via service worker (`sw.js`)
- No backend, no database, no tracking of user files

## Optional

- [IFSCPin](https://ifscpin.pages.dev/): Free bank IFSC code and India Post Pincode finder (sister project).
- [ReelSave](https://reelsave-rouge.vercel.app/): Free public Instagram Reels and MP3 audio downloader (sister project).
